mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 id, batch_no, sterilization_order_no, pallet_quantity, sterilizer_name_code, process_plan_name_code, status, invalid_flag, confirm_time, finish_time, created_at FROM dbo.produce_batch WHERE invalid_flag = '0' AND status IN ('1', '2') ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dbo.produce_batch WHERE invalid_flag = '0' AND status IN ('1', '2')
AND id != #{excludeBatchId}

SELECT b.id, b.batch_no, b.sterilization_order_no, b.pallet_quantity, b.sterilizer_name_code, b.process_plan_name_code, b.status, b.invalid_flag, b.confirm_time, b.finish_time, b.created_at FROM dbo.produce_batch b WHERE b.invalid_flag = '0'
AND b.sterilization_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sterilizationOrderNo}, '%')
AND b.created_at >= CAST(#{createdAtStart} AS DATETIME)
AND b.created_at < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CAST(#{createdAtEnd} AS DATETIME))
ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
